description: Get contents of multiple files from a remote public git repository in a single call. Reduces round-trips when you need to read several related files. Max 10 files per batch, 5000 total lines budget across all files. Each file supports optional line ranges. Failed files return per-file errors without blocking other files.

max_lines.description: Per-file safety cap on lines returned (cap: 2000).

paths.description: List of files to read. Each entry has a path and optional line range.

end_line.description: Last line to return (inclusive). If omitted, returns to end of file.

path.description: File path relative to repository root

repository.description: Full git URL of ONE public remote repository, e.g. "https://github.com/redis/redis". Required. There is no cross-repository or global search: this API analyses one repository per call, cloning it on demand. Wildcards and placeholders ("*", "all", "global", a bare host like "github.com") are rejected — if you do not have a specific repository URL, ask for one rather than guessing.

name: code_get_files
